blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The truthfulness of the statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN) filed by public officials was questioned on Tuesday as Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial focused on her SALN declarations. At the witness stand was Ombudsman Records Division officer-in-charge Karen Batu, who was presented by the prosecution team in relation to allegations that Duterte had amassed unexplained wealth and had failed not only to disclose all her and husband’s net worth, but also to divest all her business interests.
